title: Inspect and maintain Platter releases and state
summary: Understand owned release selection, canonical state, readiness, durable holds, exact drain, schema migration, backups, and safe recovery.
use_when: A reader needs installation identity, readiness scope, hold/drain guarantees, maintained migration, backup completeness, or release/schedule recovery.
do_not_use_when: The goal is preparing/sending, direct installer cutover, domain reset, unrelated Weaver cancellation, or implicit dependency upgrades.
outcome: Exact installed program/provider identity, supported state, readiness, and maintained recovery guarantees are understood without starting domain work.
effects: Matched executable/installer/provider bytes publish through owned selectors as one immutable release. Direct install/recover are refused in favor of coordinated Cell maintenance.

Durable owner-keyed holds prevent new mutations while admitted work settles. Drain observes matching requester summaries and can cancel orphaned exact matching work. Migration preserves retained identities and writes a complete current-schema backup before hashed legacy cleanup.

Readiness checks do not collect sources, read Vita works, render PDF, submit models, or send. Explicit supplied setup can initialize a missing template or create activation intent; deployment itself prepares no packets and sends no email.
authority: Platter owns domain compatibility, hold/drain scope, state migration, readiness, and product definition. Cell owns coordinated selected release sequencing and installation transactions. Nucleus owns matching execution/cancellation and Clockwork owns binding activation/incident policy.
success: Installed runtime/installer/provider identity and supported local state are verified under the run-owned hold, then full readiness and captured activation intent are verified before that hold is released.
failure_and_recovery: Foreign selectors/holds, altered release/candidate bytes, ambiguous roots, unsupported schemas, missing/conflicting migration inputs, and failed or incomplete drain stop the operation and retain recovery evidence.

Old binaries cannot operate schema seven. Binary-only rollback cannot undo migration; select a compatible candidate or explicitly chosen complete predecessor data/files backup with matching binary. Interrupted cleanup and receipts require exact unchanged evidence.
privacy: Mode-0600 database and private state/backups contain career, resume, packet, and send history. Public manifests retain only program/provider identity, modes/digests, and local paths. Nucleus history and credentials need separate backup.
does_not_authorize: Model work, sending, domain reset, foreign-hold release, unrelated Weaver cancellation, dependency upgrades, or automatic clearing of Clockwork halts.

consumers.statement: The current user and Cell coordinator inspect and maintain exact Platter program/provider installation and canonical private state.

preconditions.statement: Cutover requires an owned exact candidate, compatible maintenance interfaces across affected Nucleus requesters, the sole matching durable owner hold, and proved drain. State must use its canonical supported root. Unselected dependencies are not implicitly upgraded.

inputs.statement: Selected committed Cell source and sealed candidate identity, an exact owner, absolute private backup path, explicit missing-template/projects-template/activation setup when desired, and exact retained completion-receipt evidence for interrupted migration.

outputs.statement: Matched immutable release selectors and integrity manifests, bounded maintenance/readiness observations, a complete schema-seven recovery backup, and exact hashed legacy cleanup/completion evidence.

data_semantics.statement: All durable runtime content/settings/holds live in canonical schema-seven packets.sqlite3. Disposable Ashby cache and renderer files stay outside the database; source caches are excluded from backup. Nucleus credentials/evidence remain separately owned.
A current-schema migration backup supports current compatible recovery; it is not an old-binary rollback image. Hold owner identity is durable authority, not a process-liveness inference.

identity_and_units.statement: Installed identity is the content-addressed release manifest with exact executable/provider versions, modes, digests, and entry mappings. Migration retains packet/run IDs, requests, dates, send keys, subject/body, attachment name/order/bytes, and acceptance/uncertainty.

completeness_and_freshness.statement: Drain reads all matching nonterminal Nucleus job-summary pages for platter/job-packets and intersects Weaver summaries with retained exact Weaver IDs. Each observation is bounded to 60 seconds; failure or incompleteness cannot prove drain.

Doctor checks local state/configured PDF, executable identities, supported Cast exact URL command, Email byte payload, renderer, compatible Weaver, and strict authenticated Nucleus. It does not establish initialized source libraries or inspect the external binding. State-only reads require no external service/renderer readiness.

access.statement: Current-user owned selectors select matching CLI, recovery installer, and Chancery provider through current. Installer adapter version one is the sealed Cell boundary; direct install/recover are unavailable. Mutations hold a state-directory advisory activity lock and honor durable holds and predecessor gates/runner locks.

lifecycle_and_consistency.statement: Requester hold/drain precedes Nucleus hold; verify exact held candidate/state and full readiness before owner release, with Nucleus released last. Holds never expire. Candidate maintenance is allowed only after ownership and read-only schema-seven proof, without migration/domain work.

Schema-one import commits transactionally before backup/hashed cleanup; schemas two through six preserve legacy workflows and ordered selections while advancing to seven. Interrupted backup/cleanup retains originals and exact resumption evidence. Existing validated backup and completion receipts remain unchanged.

Deployment captures/disables an existing binding, retargets its exact definition disabled, preserves timers/environment/paths/incidents, and restores captured enabled intent after all holds release. No supplied activation intent leaves an absent binding absent.

operational_limits.statement: Maintenance cancels only matching Platter and retained Weaver assignments, not unrelated Weaver work. Candidate checks never start domain work. No state reset, implicit dependency upgrade, accepted resend, or halt clearance is part of installation.
No installation latency, arbitrary incompatible rollback, future support interval, or deprecation window is promised.

compatibility_and_evolution.statement: Schema seven preserves historical inputs/requests/artifacts/delivery meanings and ordered selected packets independent of attachments. Older binaries cannot operate it. Installation file compensation does not undo state migration. Runtime/installer/provider selection rolls back coherently only within supported state compatibility.

reliances.statement: Nucleus supplies compatible execution health and cancellation of exact matching orphaned jobs.
Clockwork supplies separately authorized binding activation, runtime history, durable failure halt, and explicit continuation.
Prerequisite probes depend on supported Cast, Annals, Weaver, Email, Nucleus, and local renderer interfaces; unselected installations are not upgraded implicitly.

Cell deployment source and cell-install transactions supply exact committed candidate preparation, sequencing, artifact integrity, and compensation; their source operation manual remains authority without an independent installed Cell contract.
Readiness and PDF configuration validation require Tectonic, Python/pypdf, and original template packages/fonts.
